content.short: Sentient is a decentralized platform for building and owning open-source AGI models.
content.description: Sentient is an ambitious decentralized AI project dedicated to creating an open-source alternative to centralized Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). The platform provides a collaborative framework where developers, researchers, and data providers can contribute to the development of powerful AI models that are community-owned and transparent. Sentient aims to democratize access to advanced AI technology and ensure that the future of AGI is built on principles of openness, meritocracy, and shared ownership. By leveraging blockchain, Sentient ensures that AI development remains decentralized and incentive-aligned.
content.meta: Sentient is a decentralized network for the collaborative development of open-source AGI. Discover Sentient and other Blockchains on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
